### Props

| Name      | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `content` | `union` |          | `\{\}`  | The widget's persisted configuration blob. An optional `route` (vue-router location) or `link` (external href) turns the whole tile into a click-through target (see the widgetLink mixin). The `source` resolves the value. Besides the OpenRegister-backed kinds (plain aggregate / `ratio` / `computed` / `weighted`), an `{ kind: 'endpoint', url, path?, params? }` source reads an arbitrary app REST endpoint and extracts the value at the dot-`path` of the response (default = whole body). The `url` and any string `params` value interpolate `@page.&lt;param&gt;` / `@workspace.&lt;param&gt;` tokens from the page-level context (and `@objectId` / `@object.&lt;field&gt;` on a detail page) — so a page-rendered period selector can drive every endpoint KPI. |
